data.name: Arsan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Ars’ meaning mountain, Arsan is a name of great power and strength. In Islamic history, Prophet Moses (AS) is said to have carried the Ark of the Covenant, a symbol of faith and divine guidance, up a mountain (Mount Sinai). Arsan is a reminder of the steadfastness, courage, and unwavering commitment that one can possess, like the unyielding mountain.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of strength and courage, rooted in the faith and guidance of Prophet Moses.
data.numerology_meaning: Intuitive, sensitive, and caring, Arsan is a name of deep emotional intelligence. They possess a unique ability to understand and connect with others, making them natural leaders and healers.

in_arabic.name: أرسان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على القوة و الشجاعة في المعارك
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أرسان يعود إلى الأصول العربية و يعني الشخص القوي و الشجاع في المعارك و الحروب. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تدل على الصفات الحميدة و النبيلة و التي يرغب الكثيرون في تسمية أبنائهم بها. كما أنه يوحي بالعزيمة و الإرادة القوية.

in_urdu.name: ارسان
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو طاقت اور بہادری کی علامت ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارسان ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے طاقتور اور بہادر۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مشہور ہے کیونکہ یہ بہادری اور قوت کی علامت ہے۔ اردو زبان میں اس نام کا استعمال عام ہے اور یہ جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمان والدین کے درمیان مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अर्सान
in_hindi.meaning: एक नाम जो शक्ति और बहादुरी का प्रतीक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अर्सान एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ होता है शक्तिशाली और बहादुर। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और आदर्शों को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयुक्त है जो अपने बच्चों में बहादुरी और आत्मविश्वास की भावना पैदा करना चाहते हैं।

in_pashto.name: ارسن
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارسن نوم د عربي اصلي نوم دی چې د قوي او زړور سړي مانا ورکوي. په افغانستان کې دغه نوم ډیر مشهور دی او د ډیرو خلکو لخوا کارول کیږي. دا نوم د پښتنو دودیزو نومونو څخه دی چې د قوت او مردانگی څرګندونه کوي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arsan holds a strong cultural significance for various reasons. In Islamic history, mountains hold immense importance as symbols of strength, spirituality, and sanctity. Mountains are often associated with moments of revelation, trials, and victories. Additionally, the name Arsen, though uncommon, may be perceived as a connection to the legendary hero Orion, a constellation regarded by some cultures as a man carrying a shield upon his shoulders, making the name synonymous with bravery and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arsan carries profound spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. Arsan is derived from the Arabic root 'Ars,' which means mountain. In the Islamic tradition, mountains are often considered sacred places of connection between the divine and the physical world. The mountain's solidity and unwavering foundation serve as metaphors for one's own unwavering faith and commitment to God. The name Arsan reminds us of the mountain of Al-Tur, which Muslims believe that Prophet Ibrahim (AS) built as a symbol of submission to God. It also symbolizes the steadfastness and firmness of religious belief and practice, mirrored by the unchanging nature of mountains. Furthermore, the Biblical story of Prophet Moses (AS) receiving divine revelation on Mount Sinai adds to the spiritual depth of this unique name.
